conventions.statement: Data-driven difficulty tuning — designer sets projected curve, playtest actual win-rate reconciles it; tune via move-count toward a target vanilla win-rate.
Near-miss engineering — give ~exactly the average moves so the player wins-on-last or loses-by-one, prompting a one-more-move purchase.
Meta-narrative as retention engine — star-gated renovation/story; the story pull is what monetizes, not the decoration itself. Meta is NOT a saga-map.
Star = single bridge currency — 1 star per level beaten, spent on meta tasks. Can't buy progress, only earn it.
Lives economy — 5 lives, 1 regenerated per 30 min (extendable to 8 via pass). Soft gate + urgency.
Systematic mechanic drip — a new obstacle/element introduced about every 10 levels; never overwhelm.
Generous, readable power-ups — big-radius/re-targeting; larger pieces with distinct color+shape for fast board reads.
Designed for return-frequency, not session-length — levels target ≤5 min, instant re-entry (no loading screens), event calendar drives dailies.
Move-compression over progression — early levels generous (14-33 moves), late levels tight (12-18) to build tension gradually.
Difficulty tiers with reward multipliers — Normal / Hard (3x) / Super-Hard (5x) / Challenge (5x first-try-only).
Single-currency elegance — coins only, no hard/soft split, no video ads (Elovikov first-party intent).

anti_tropes.statement: Pure-merge confusion — match3-with-meta is NOT pure-merge (Merge Mansion/Dragons). Don't blend a merge-board into the match3 core.
Meta-as-afterthought — bolting decoration on without an emotional/narrative hook fails; the pull is what monetizes, not the decoration.
Intuition-tuned difficulty — tuning without playtest completion data produces churn spikes. Instrument completion from first playtest.

pillars.name: 정직한 긴장 (Honest tension)
pillars.anti_example: A loss the player can't see coming, or a wall that feels arbitrary/random rather than one-move-away.

pillars.name: 켜자마자 손에 붙는 폴리시 (Instant tactile polish)
pillars.anti_example: Small fiddly pieces, loading screens between levels, weightless/silent matches.

pillars.name: 진척 자체가 보상 (Progression IS the reward)
pillars.anti_example: Progress that's purchasable, or a meta that needs a narrative/decoration the user didn't choose (Royal-Match-style = pure progression, NOT scapes decoration meta).

modules.name: Match-3 core board (swap-match-clear + readable power-ups)
modules.playable_html: HTML board where player swaps adjacent pieces, matches 3+ clear, power-ups spawn from formations; a level has a move limit and a target; losing-by-one-move is reachable. Bot can drive swaps via __gmk_botHook__.
modules._ratified: user 2026-05-29 — first build target (most independent, proves polish+tension pillars directly)

modules.name: Level progression + difficulty curve (move-limit levels, mechanic drip)
modules.playable_html: A sequence of levels with tightening move budgets and a new obstacle ~every 10 levels; difficulty tiers visible; win/lose gates the next level.

modules.name: Star-gated progression meta (no decoration — pure forward progress)
modules.playable_html: Win a level → earn 1 star → spend star to unlock the next progression node (Royal-Match-style: pure progress, NOT decoration). Visible forward map.

modules.name: Lives + session economy (5 lives / 30min, ≤5min levels)
modules.playable_html: Lives counter (max 5, regen timer), instant level re-entry, single coin currency. Soft-gates replay without hard wall.
